column1: # India event-day calendar for NIFTY premium-selling hard-block.
#   date        — ISO yyyy-mm-dd (the calendar day we're blocking)
#   event_type  — RBI_POLICY | FED_FOMC | BUDGET | CPI_IN | IIP_IN | ELECTION | OTHER
#   severity    — HARD_BLOCK (skip entries) | SOFT_CAUTION (score penalty only)
#   HIGH  — RBI MPC decision days (sourced from rbi.org.in releases)
#           releases). Dates are the **second/final day** of multi-day events
#           because that is when the rate decision is published and the NIFTY
#   MED   — CPI / IIP release days: NSO's pattern is "CPI ~12th & IIP ~12th
#           of each month" but the exact date slides 1-3 days. Entries here
#           are the canonical 12th; operators should fold in the official
#   LOW   — Election result days: 2024 Lok Sabha result day was 4-Jun-2024
#           (confirmed). 2025 state-election dates are not listed here.
# FOMC effect on NIFTY: decision drops at 23:30 IST → the **next** IST
# ── 2024 FOMC decision days (second day; IST next-session effect) ─
# ── 2024 CPI / IIP canonical release dates (MED confidence) ────────
